messages:
maria: FYI new hire Jorge P flagged for "address mismatch" on the background check. start date is Wed. do we want to keep Wed or push to Thu?
kevin (recruiter): candidate is flexible. he's driving back Tues night so can provide updated proof of address Wed morning if needed. prefers Wed if we can do remote verif.
harper (onboarding): we can do a remote I-9 via accredited agent or have him bring docs to office. remote requires clear scans of ID + proof of address dated within 60 days. recommend giving until 11am Wed to submit.
security-bot: Reminder: if provisional clearance granted, restrict repo and VPN access until final verification.
sam (it): laptop staging ok. we need recipient name, delivery address, and phone. we don't ship to PO boxes. if sending to temporary address (hotel/Airbnb), require confirmation email with exact address and check-in dates.
kevin (recruiter): asked for driver's license front/back and a PDF of a bank statement or utility bill. candidate sent license pic at 1806123600 and texted he'll email bank stmt tomorrow morning.
maria: can we run a provisional onboarding session remotely Wed 9am and mark it optional until docs finalized?
harper (onboarding): yes. we can host intro + benefits overview remotely, label it "provisional attendance". if docs not in by 11am, we move formal access to Thu and schedule a 20m sync Wed afternoon to hand off any paperwork.
sam (it): create temporary account with limited access if he needs to test things on day1. no SSO provisioning until final OK.
kevin (recruiter): candidate ok with that. also prefers Mac. sending name/legal with machine request now.
security-bot: Scheduled follow-up task set for 1806200000 to confirm docs received.
maria: plan: keep Wed onboarding as provisional 9am, request docs by 11am, stage Mac but hold shipment until bank stmt received, grant limited account if needed. action items: kevin - collect docs and hotel/addr confirmation; sam - stage laptop and prepare temp account; harper - send provisional onboarding invite + i-9 instructions. any other concerns?
